goal: Repair Codex Stop hook cursor permission failure with writable fallback
body:
## Active Incidents
- Resolved: Stop hook inbox cursor hit PermissionError at `C:\Users\super\.codex\inbox\.nougen_seen.json.tmp`.

## Recent Changes
- `tools/codex_inbox_hook.py` now reads/writes configured state first, then project-local `.codex/.nougen_seen.json` fallback on filesystem errors.
- Exact `codex_stop_guard.py` invocation now exits 0 and emits valid `{}` JSON; fallback cursor created.

## Known Issues & Workarounds
- Existing log contains historical PermissionError traces; current run no longer appends a new failure.
- Full suite has an unrelated pre-existing collection error in `tests/test_harness_gills_scale.py`.

## Done When
- Next real Codex Stop event reports no hook failure and inbox cursor advances.

relay.note: Actionable-heavy: Local hook/config repair on the Codex-running machine(s) — cursor permission failure needs a writable fallback, and Stop-hook lockout behavior needs to change to advisory. Both are local machine/config changes relay-watch cannot reach or apply from this isolated session. Queued as TODO `20260904T135953Z__ccr__claude-cli` for the blade/claude-cli lane. Source leg left open.

Closed on phoebus: active consolidated ~/.codex/hooks/nougen_lifecycle.py supersedes the older split guards. Exact Stop invocation exited 0, emitted continue=true, advanced lifecycle state 3->4, and py_compile passed; no inbox deletion or relay mutation.
